$comment: SHARED CONTRACT FIXTURE - keep byte-identical in hots and hots-connector. Direction: HOTS -> hots-connector, on the topic named by connector.parameters.topic_moves. Each Kafka message is one object from `messages` below.
notes: `time` is stamped by the connector at publish time (the tick the move applies from), not by the placement heuristic.
`v` is stamped by placement._move() itself (the single wire-shape-emitting helper), unlike `time` which is added later at publish time.
The file connector writes these same objects as JSONL, one per line, with `time` as a string.
Every HOTS move producer goes through placement._move(), so this is the only shape emitted; add new heuristics via that helper.
`old_host` may be null when the container had no prior placement.
`v` is the message schema version (currently 1). Consumers must tolerate it being absent (a pre-versioning sender) but should warn on an unrecognized value rather than fail outright.
